title: The Labyrinth Mouse Path Counter
statement:
A mouse is trapped in an N x N maze starting at top-left (0, 0) and must reach destination (N - 1, N - 1). The maze consists of 1s (open paths) and 0s (blocked walls).

The mouse can move in 4 directions: Up, Down, Left, Right, but cannot visit any cell more than once on the same path.

Print the total number of distinct paths from (0, 0) to (N - 1, N - 1).
inputFormat:
First line: Integer N.
Next N lines: N space-separated 0s or 1s.
outputFormat: Print the total count of valid paths.

sampleCases.explanation: Exactly 2 distinct paths reach the destination.
